diffuseAlbedo.source: M. Vacek, V. Krivy, K. Kreislova, M. Vlachova, M. Kubzova, 'Experimental Measurement of Deposition Chloride Ions in the Vicinity of Road Cut', Materials (Basel) 16(1):88 (2022/2023), Table 23 (colorimetric parameters of exposed Corten A coupons, BYK Spectro-Guide Gloss S, exposure 3 Nov 2020 - 20 Dec 2021) and Table 31 (XRD: lepidocrocite 65-83 %, goethite 17-35 %, akaganeite 1-2 %), https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9821097/
diffuseAlbedo.note: Verified: Table 23 opened and the values match. Recomputed mean gives [0.1073, 0.0536, 0.0388]. The per-coupon green maximum computes to 0.073 (stated 0.074, a rounding difference). The XRD fractions are in Table 31, not Table 23. This is measured rust on weathering steel (Corten A, not S355) after about 13 months outdoors near a road with de-icing chloride: the first, lepidocrocite-rich rust. The paper does not state illuminant or observer, so D65 is assumed. Horizontal coupons are redder and darker than vertical ones. The old first value (Y 0.063) was close in lightness but too saturated.

refractiveIndex.source: webmineral.com Lepidocrocite ('Biaxial (+), a=1.94, b=2.2, g=2.51'), https://www.webmineral.com/data/Lepidocrocite.shtml ; webmineral.com Goethite (alpha 2.26-2.275, beta 2.393-2.409, gamma 2.398-2.515), https://www.webmineral.com/data/Goethite.shtml ; phase fractions: Vacek et al., Materials 16(1):88 (PMC9821097), Table 31, lepidocrocite 65-83 %, goethite 17-35 %
refractiveIndex.note: Verified: both webmineral pages opened and the indices match. The arithmetic reproduces. min and max are the lowest and highest principal indices of the two phases. The indices are crystal values (sodium light), and a porous rust crust's effective index is lower, which this does not model.
refractiveIndex.derivation: Mean principal index of lepidocrocite (1.94 + 2.20 + 2.51)/3 = 2.217 and of goethite (2.268 + 2.401 + 2.457)/3 = 2.375 (range midpoints), weighted 0.75/0.25 by the measured rust phase fractions: 0.75 x 2.217 + 0.25 x 2.375 = 2.256. (The five coupons' mean normalised lepidocrocite fraction, 0.758, gives 2.255.)
